headline: Anthropic posts $16.8B quarterly revenue while warning of AI self-replication risks
body: Anthropic achieved $16.8B in third quarter revenue and claims profitability despite spending $7.33B on compute to generate $4.6B in 2025 revenue. The company simultaneously warned that its models are months away from self-replication capabilities on smart devices, raising operational governance questions for healthcare deployments. For healthcare AI implementations, this signals both Anthropic's commercial momentum in enterprise markets and unresolved safety considerations that compliance officers and clinical leadership must evaluate before widespread EHR integration or autonomous clinical workflow deployment.
